backend/main.mo: Implements access-controlled user profile storage and product creation with metadata, exposing query and update methods.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping new preview-related features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of many frontend source files for reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global theme variables for light and dark modes and applies base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint loading jsPDF and JSZip via CDN and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application controller managing authentication, profile setup, view navigation, and generated bundle state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout with query cache reset.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog prompting first‑time users to enter and save their profile name.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: Displays step‑by‑step instructions and platform-specific guidance for exporting and selling generated products.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: UI for downloading individual or all product bundles, handling ZIP/PDF downloads and errors.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Top‑level layout providing header, navigation buttons, authentication display, and view‑specific actions.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Modal showing onboarding instructions with embedded export instructions and a dismiss button.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Displays an iframe preview of a PDF blob or an alert when no PDF is available.
frontend/src/components/preview/UnifiedP: Shows a combined preview of all products with descriptions, cover images, and PDF previews.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Lists expected ZIP file contents for a product, including templates, checklists, and prompts.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Editor for configuring product details, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists with generate action.
Renders the product editing workspace, loads/saves drafts, and triggers PDF/ZIP bundle generation for single or all products.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading saved identities and exposing login/clear functions with status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Manages onboarding modal visibility with localStorage persistence and auto-open logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save the caller’s user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, CSS variables for themes, and utility classes including touch scrolling.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Maps product IDs to cover image paths and provides helpers to resolve and fetch cover images.
frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts: Defines the default product entries with metadata, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Utility functions for triggering client-side downloads of blobs and files.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates slugified, dated filenames for PDFs, ZIPs, and full product bundles.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Sequentially generates bundles for all products and reports optional progress.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Builds a product bundle by fetching the cover, generating a PDF, packaging it into a ZIP, and returning metadata.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Handles loading, saving, and resetting product drafts in localStorage with version checks.
Generates a product PDF using jsPDF, including cover, title, modules, and prompts.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Builds a master ZIP containing multiple product ZIPs plus a consolidated README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Creates a ZIP for a single product including its PDF, cover, templates, checklists, prompts, and README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Provides helper functions that generate standardized README sections for product ZIPs.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for product entries, modules, and generated bundles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, plugins, and design tokens for the frontend.
project_state.json: Contains project metadata, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of existing features for a digital product generator app. Tracks versions, problems like non-scrollable instructions, and requirements for product creation, exporting, and backend persistence.
